evidence.post_text:
Welcome to the community, Sarker.

n8n does run a start-up plan for smaller teams. Eligible early-stage startups get 50% off the self-hosted Business plan for one year or longer. The published eligibility bar is fewer than 20 employees and less than 5M EUR in total funding, and you apply through the form at n8n.io/pricing/startup-plan.

For your second question on finding programs more broadly, there is a public registry called Sourcey that catalogs startup offers with the source page and the date each fact was last read. Their n8n entry is here: [sourcey.com/c/n8n](https://sourcey.com/c/n8n). The catalog covers a few hundred vendors, so it is a practical way to check which other tools in your stack, like CRM or email or support products, also run startup or small business programs.

Since you are in education, it is also worth asking n8n support directly whether anything beyond the start-up plan applies to education businesses. That question comes up in the community now and then.
